item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh's metal pan on a flame, its wooden handle, and a woollen wrap he can place around a hot metal mug.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which material choice matches the heat-flow need?

options.text: Metal for the pan, because easy heat flow from the flame to the food is wanted.
Metal for the handle, because reduced heat flow to the hand is wanted.
Wood for the pan, because easy heat flow from the flame to the food is wanted.

parts.text: Why does a dry woollen wrap slow heat loss from the hot mug better than the same wrap soaked with water?
